sentences.l2: 不同地方的人看时间不一样。
sentences.l1: People in different places see time differently.
Some people like to be on time.

sentences.l2: 约会或上课，他们早早到。
sentences.l1: For appointments or classes, they arrive early.

sentences.l2: 时间观念不一样，没关系。
sentences.l1: Different ideas about time are fine.

sentences.l2: 有些人写日程安排，每天看。
sentences.l1: Some people write down a schedule and look at it every day.

sentences.l2: 有些人记得事情，不写字。
sentences.l1: Some people remember things and do not write them down.

sentences.l2: 全球化让不同文化的人常见面。
sentences.l1: Globalization lets people from different cultures meet often.
Everyone needs to understand each other.
You are punctual, and I respect you.
I take my time, so do not be angry with me.
